name: synthesize_COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O

input.prompt:
Propose a retrosynthesis route to synthesize the molecule with SMILES COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O. The route must have at least 1 reaction. The leaves on the retrosynthesis tree should be commercially available chemicals.

Here are some hints to help you (the hints are enumerated in the order that they should be applied): In a cycloaddition reaction, two unsaturated molecules (or parts of the same molecule) combine to form a cyclic product. The reaction typically involves the formation of new sigma bonds between the reacting species, resulting in the creation of a ring structure.
